data_notes: City-scale map of the City of San Diego (ANSI place 0666000). Street + water geometry is from the U.S. Census TIGER/Line 2024 ROADS (S1100 interstates + S1200 arterials) and AREAWATER shapefiles for San Diego County (FIPS 06073), clipped to the City of San Diego place boundary — all public domain.

City boundary polygon from the Census TIGERweb Incorporated Places layer (PLACE 66000), generalized (~0.002°). Boundary holes (enclaves such as Coronado / National City) are not cut out — the schematic fills the outer place ring.

District/neighbourhood labels (Downtown, La Jolla, Point Loma, Pacific Beach, North Park, Hillcrest, Mission Valley) and progressive place-labels are curated real-place point-labels — no authoritative neighbourhood-polygon source; coordinates position the label and are never shown (R33).
Fine local-street mesh (S1400) is intentionally omitted for this pilot; the overview renders arteries + interstates only.
